unresolved_required_configuration.title: Category codes: keep CUP / CAK / CHO / DON / GIF / EXT
Tax / VAT mapping and price tax-treatment
Odoo product type classification (Stockable / Consumable / Service)
Opening inventory quantity at first Odoo import

category.notes: Standard Odoo external-id pattern — see docs/integrations/odoo-external-key-strategy.md; no xml_id is created in this phase.
No standard Odoo field for a short category code (D03) — stays PostgreSQL-only unless a genuine integration need for it inside Odoo is identified.
No standard Odoo field for a URL slug — PostgreSQL-only, matches D06.
product.category.name is Odoo's standard category name field.

Requires Arabic (ar_001/ar_SA) installed and activated as an Odoo language, then a translated `name` value via ir.translation — not a separate field. Not checked by fields_get; verified via the language-activation check instead (see D13).
No standard product.category description field is used by this app's UI; treated as PostgreSQL/merchandising-owned like the rest of category copy.
Not used today (D02: flat, 6 categories) — field exists in Odoo for future hierarchy.
Standard Odoo active flag. ('active' not found on product.category in fields_get)
Storefront display order is Admin-owned merchandising data, not an Odoo concept (final-data-ownership.md).

product.notes: Same external-id strategy as categories — see identifier-mapping-register.md (D20).
default_code ('Internal Reference') lives on the variant (product.product), not the template — 1:1 for single-variant products, per-variant for buttercream-cake.
No standard Odoo field for a URL slug — PostgreSQL-only, matches D06.
product.template.name is the standard product name field.
Same Arabic-translation caveat as category name_ar.
description_sale ('Sales Description') is the customer-facing field — description (internal notes) is the wrong target.
Same Arabic-translation caveat.
No standard Odoo field distinct from description_sale for a short/teaser description — PostgreSQL/merchandising-owned.
Standard many2one to product.category.
Standard Odoo Consumable/Storable/Service classification (D10).
Standard UoM field (D09).
Standard Odoo active flag.
Standard 'Can be Sold' flag.
Standard template sales price — pricelist interaction is D08.
Company/pricelist currency setting, not a per-product field — verified via company_currency check (D07).
Standard many2many to account.tax — real record TBD (D08).
Base64 image_1920; Odoo auto-derives smaller variants.
Extra Product Media gallery model (Odoo 15+) — see product.image model-availability check; only buttercream-cake needs this (3 gallery thumbnails).
Odoo's internal numeric id — stored alongside external_key, never used as the sync join key itself (numeric ids are not stable across a reimport).
Same caveat as product template ID.
